settings.question: Do they fit true to size?
settings.answer: Generally yes. If you are between sizes, most people go up half a size. Each product page carries a fit note for that exact pair.

settings.question: Are they authentic?
settings.answer: Every pair is inspected by hand and compared against known genuine references before it leaves us. You get a verification note in the box.

settings.question: How fast will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 3pm dispatch the same day. Delivery estimates by country appear on every product page.

settings.question: Can I return them if they do not fit?
settings.answer: Unworn pairs in their original box can be returned within 30 days. Full details are on the returns page.

settings.question: Can I get an alert when my size is back?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose your size on any sold-out pair and leave your email. We only message you about that size.
